start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:put-it-where-it-belongs for the part: the file pricing-table.json that lives inside the checkout page folder but is also read by the invoice emails."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Name the part to check: a file, folder, feature, setting or tool (at least 3 characters).
2. Say "Run workflow:put-it-where-it-belongs" with part set to it. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps job, owner, move.
3. At job, read the plain-words job (without saying where it lives now) and who needs it; at owner, read which place should hold that job and why each other place is wrong.
4. At move, the part goes to its owner, everything that used the old place is updated, the old copy is deleted with no pointer left, and the proof it works from the new place is given.
